records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Harbor Logistics* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: Positive signals: first project reached day 1 and 1 invite sent on a Team plan, 8 days left, no tickets or blockers. Negative: no reply to either outreach (email:d55d6c79, email:adc8d4fb) and no key_milestone by day 6, suggesting slow self-driven momentum.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on my last note — now that Harbor Logistics has a first project and a teammate in Wrenfield, the usual next step is getting real work flowing through it: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how you'd like Harbor Logistics' work mapped out, and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Nadia
